title: TotemReborn
description: more totems with more effects and skills
body:
# TotemReborn

> Custom Totems of Undying with passive effects, active skills, rarity tiers, cooldowns, and up to 5 resurrection charges.

## Overview

TotemReborn transforms the vanilla Totem of Undying into a progression-based system featuring passive abilities, active skills, rarity tiers, and multiple resurrection charges.

Perfect for SMPs, Survival servers, RPG experiences, boss fights, and Vanilla+ gameplay.

---

## Features

### Multiple Resurrection Charges

| Rarity    | Color        | Max Charges |
| --------- | ------------ | ----------- |
| Common    | White        | 1           |
| Uncommon  | Green        | 2           |
| Rare      | Aqua         | 3           |
| Epic      | Light Purple | 4           |
| Legendary | Gold         | 5           |

* Charges are consumed only when preventing death.
* Active skills do not consume charges.
* Charges are stored directly on the item.

---

## Totems

| Totem          | Rarity    | Charges | Passive Effects                   | Active Skill  | Cooldown |
| -------------- | --------- | ------- | --------------------------------- | ------------- | -------- |
| Fire Totem     | Common    | 1       | Fire Resistance                   | Lava Burst    | 60s      |
| Ocean Totem    | Common    | 1       | Water Breathing, Dolphin's Grace  | Tidal Dash    | 60s      |
| Warrior Totem  | Uncommon  | 2       | Strength I                        | Battle Cry    | 90s      |
| Guardian Totem | Uncommon  | 2       | Resistance I                      | Fortify       | 90s      |
| Explorer Totem | Uncommon  | 2       | Speed I                           | Blink         | 45s      |
| Champion Totem | Rare      | 3       | Strength I, Resistance I          | Last Stand    | 120s     |
| Phoenix Totem  | Epic      | 4       | Fire Resistance, Speed I          | Rebirth       | 180s     |
| Voyager Totem  | Rare      | 3       | Water Breathing, Speed I          | Ocean Sprint  | 90s      |
| Dragon Totem   | Epic      | 4       | Slow Falling, Resistance I        | Dragon Leap   | 90s      |
| Titan Totem    | Legendary | 5       | Strength I, Resistance I, Haste I | Titan's Wrath | 180s     |

---

## Active Skill Summary

| Skill         | Effect                                                      |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| Lava Burst    | Flame attack that damages, ignites, and knocks back enemies |
| Tidal Dash    | Launches player forward with water buffs                    |
| Battle Cry    | Grants combat buffs and knocks back nearby enemies          |
| Fortify       | Provides Resistance and Absorption                          |
| Blink         | Teleports player forward to a safe location                 |
| Last Stand    | Grants multiple powerful combat buffs                       |
| Rebirth       | Heals and grants regeneration and fire protection           |
| Ocean Sprint  | High-speed movement with aquatic buffs                      |
| Dragon Leap   | Powerful leap with aerial protection                        |
| Titan's Wrath | Heavy area damage and crowd control                         |

---

## Commands

### Give Totem

```bash
/totem give <player> <totem_type>
```

Available IDs:

```text
fire
ocean
warrior
guardian
explorer
champion
phoenix
voyager
dragon
titan
```

Permission: `totemreborn.command.totem`

### Reload Plugin

```bash
/totemreborn reload
```

Permission: `totemreborn.command.reload`

---

## Cooldown System

* Separate cooldown per player
* Separate cooldown per totem type
* Survives server restarts
* Anti-spam protection
* Automatically cleans expired cooldowns

Storage:

```text
plugins/TotemReborn/cooldowns.yml
```

---

## Resurrection System

When a custom totem activates:

1. Death is prevented.
2. One charge is consumed.
3. Remaining charges are updated.
4. Totem stays if charges remain.
5. Totem breaks after the final charge is used.

Includes:

* Item break effects
* Sounds
* Particles
* Action bar notifications

---

## Compatibility

* Paper 1.21.11+
* Java 21

---

## Perfect For

* Survival Servers
* SMPs
* RPG Servers
* Adventure Servers
* PvE Content
* Boss Fights
* Vanilla+ Gameplay

Enhance Minecraft's Totem of Undying with unique abilities, strategic gameplay, and progression-based resurrection mechanics.
